notes.title: 🎮 Achievements & Leaderboards Update - Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! First off, thank you so much for your patience while I took some time with family. I'm back and excited to bring you this new update to the main game!
What's New:
✅ Leaderboards and Achievements are here! Track your high scores and compete with other channel surfers

🎮 UI Improvements:

Players can now hide the UI interface for a cleaner experience

Added volume range controls with updated icons

Cleaned up the UX for pets

🔧 Technical Updates:

Updated save/load manager to support new volume and UI hide settings

Enhanced game manager integration for achievements and leaderboards

Improved main menu functionality

Your feedback during the beta was invaluable in polishing these features. Thank you to everyone who participated in testing!

Happy surfing! 📺

How to Access:[olist]
Right-click Channel Surfing in your Steam library

Select Properties → Betas

Choose "achievement_beta - Achievement and Leaderboard Beta" from the dropdown

Steam will update your game to the beta branch

notes.notes:
Made updates to window support for multiple screens

notes.title: Hotfix 3
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes & Stability
Fixed TV startup issue: TV now properly starts in "on" state instead of defaulting to off
Resolved fidget spinner crash: Applied hotfix to prevent game crashes when navigating to Channel 1
Channel 3 Dog animation improvements: Fixed positioning and animation glitches affecting dog

UI/UX Improvements

Enhanced main menu: Updated visual design and added support for additional settings options
Smart TV controls: Main menu button now properly toggles TV power state when pressed
Channel 2 Expanded input support: Button interactions now accept right-click, left-click, and middle-click inputs

Gameplay & Controls

Channel 3 Auto-click system overhaul on progress channel:

 Improved timing accuracy for auto-click features
 Resolved interference between auto-click and manual clicking
 Enhanced progress rate calculations
 Better synchronization between automated and player actions

notes.title: Hotfix 2
notes.notes: Debug keys were still registered in the final build. Have now removed them. If this has happened to you, you will need to reinstall the game. Apologize for the this issue

notes.title: Hotfix 1
notes.notes:
Hotfix Log - Latest UpdateBug Fixes & ImprovementsCore Gameplay
Fixed stamina regeneration when player is away - Stamina now properly regenerates off channel

Corrected upgrade order and treasure mound drops - Items and upgrades now follow proper progression order

Bubble popping responsiveness - Bubbles now pop without delay
User Interface
Fixed Chew text display issue - Text no longer appears off-screen and is properly positioned

Removed debug label from spaceship interface - Cleaned up development artifacts from production build

Corrected skill tree tab ordering - Skill tree tabs now display in the intended sequence

Gold mound subtraction - When gold is spent mound retracts
Save System & Progression
Fixed bubble popped counter not saving - Player progress for bubble popping now persists correctly

Fixed dog pet counter tracking - Pet interaction counters now save and display accurately

Skill manager functionality restored - All skill management features are now operational
Pet System
Cleaned up pet evolution interface - Removed unnecessary UI elements from pet evolution screens
[hr][/hr]
All fixes have been tested and are now live. Players should see improvements immediately upon loading the game.
